mechanism: Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) enhances acetylcholine effects while oxybutynin (anticholinergic) antagonizes them, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects that reduce therapeutic efficacy and may cause unpredictable outcomes.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with caution; monitor cognitive and urinary symptoms closely if combination is necessary, as oxybutynin may diminish galantamine's therapeutic benefits in dementia.
